title: Exploring New Frontiers in Citizen Participation in the Policy Cycle
discussion_signal: The discussion identifies shared understanding, coordination, front-office/back-office alignment, and accountability for citizen input as conditions for participation to become meaningful rather than consultative theatre.
linked_research_question: How does citizen participation move from consultation rhetoric toward a governance-capacity test where timing, institutional skill, feedback, and policy-cycle placement determine influence?
limits: The post describes a framework and does not evaluate specific pilots
It does not measure whether citizens’ inputs changed decisions
The OECD framing may not capture adversarial or informal participation
